@claude what time does the science museum in south ken close and is entry free? Is it open sunday

Yes, it's open Sunday. Time Out lists 10am to 6pm every day, with last entry at 5:15pm. The permanent collection is free. Wonderlab, the IMAX and Power Up cost extra. Opening times can change, so check the museum's website before you go.

https://www.timeout.com/london/museums/science-museum
